select count(*) as aggregate from `roles` inner join `user_roles` on `roles`.`id` = `user_roles`.`role_id` where `user_roles`.`user_id` = 1 and exists (select * from `role_translations` where `roles`.`id` = `role_translations`.`role_id` and `role_translations`.`name` = 'admin' and `locale` in ('tr', 'tr'))

select `roles`.*, `user_roles`.`user_id` as `pivot_user_id`, `user_roles`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id`, `user_roles`.`created_at` as `pivot_created_at`, `user_roles`.`updated_at` as `pivot_updated_at` from `roles` inner join `user_roles` on `roles`.`id` = `user_roles`.`role_id` where `user_roles`.`user_id` = 1
select * from `role_translations` where `role_translations`.`role_id` in (1) and `locale` in ('tr', 'tr')

select DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as orders, SUM(total) as revenue from `orders` where `status` not in ('canceled', 'refunded') and `created_at` between '2025-11-25 00:00:00' and '2025-12-24 23:59:59' and `orders`.`deleted_at` is null group by DATE(created_at) order by DATE(created_at) asc

select DATE(c.last_order_at) as date, SUM(CASE WHEN c.first_order_at >= '2025-11-25 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as new_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN c.first_order_at < '2025-11-25 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as returning_customers from (select COALESCE(CAST(customer_id AS CHAR), CONCAT('email:', customer_email)) as customer_key, MIN(created_at) as first_order_at, MAX(created_at) as last_order_at from `orders` where `status` not in ('canceled', 'refunded') and `orders`.`deleted_at` is null group by `customer_key`) as `c` where `c`.`last_order_at` between '2025-11-25 00:00:00' and '2025-12-24 23:59:59' group by DATE(c.last_order_at) order by DATE(c.last_order_at) asc

select x.product_id as product_id, x.product_variant_id as product_variant_id, MAX(x.product_name) as product_name, MAX(x.product_image_path) as product_image_path, MAX(x.unit_label) as unit_label, MAX(x.unit_short_suffix) as unit_short_suffix, MAX(pv.name) as variant_name, MAX(x.variant_label) as variant_label, SUM(x.qty) as orders_qty, SUM(x.line_total) as revenue from (select op.id as order_product_id, op.product_id as product_id, op.product_variant_id as product_variant_id, MAX(op.product_name) as product_name, MAX(op.product_image_path) as product_image_path, MAX(op.unit_label) as unit_label, MAX(op.unit_short_suffix) as unit_short_suffix, op.qty as qty, op.line_total as line_total, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT opv.value ORDER BY opv.id SEPARATOR ' / ') as variant_label from `order_products` as `op` inner join `orders` as `o` on `o`.`id` = `op`.`order_id` left join `order_product_variations` as `opv` on `opv`.`order_product_id` = `op`.`id` where `o`.`deleted_at` is null and `o`.`status` not in ('canceled', 'refunded') and `o`.`created_at` between '2025-11-25 00:00:00' and '2025-12-24 23:59:59' group by `op`.`id`, `op`.`product_id`, `op`.`product_variant_id`, `op`.`qty`, `op`.`line_total`) as `x` left join `product_variants` as `pv` on `pv`.`id` = `x`.`product_variant_id` group by `x`.`product_id`, `x`.`product_variant_id`, `x`.`variant_label` order by `orders_qty` desc limit 10
select * from `products` where `id` in (19)
select * from `product_translations` where `product_translations`.`product_id` in (19) and `locale` in ('tr', 'tr')

select `files`.*, `entity_files`.`entity_id` as `pivot_entity_id`, `entity_files`.`file_id` as `pivot_file_id`, `entity_files`.`entity_type` as `pivot_entity_type`, `entity_files`.`id` as `pivot_id`, `entity_files`.`zone` as `pivot_zone`, `entity_files`.`alt_text` as `pivot_alt_text`, `entity_files`.`created_at` as `pivot_created_at`, `entity_files`.`updated_at` as `pivot_updated_at` from `files` inner join `entity_files` on `files`.`id` = `entity_files`.`file_id` where `entity_files`.`entity_id` in (19) and `entity_files`.`entity_type` = 'Modules\\Product\\Entities\\Product' and `entity_files`.`zone` = 'base_image'
select * from `product_variants` where `id` in (26, 29, 28, 27, 23, 43, 14, 13, 44)

select p.primary_category_id as category_id, MAX(ct.name) as name, SUM(op.qty) as orders_qty, SUM(op.line_total) as revenue from `order_products` as `op` inner join `orders` as `o` on `o`.`id` = `op`.`order_id` inner join `products` as `p` on `p`.`id` = `op`.`product_id` left join `category_translations` as `ct` on `ct`.`category_id` = `p`.`primary_category_id` and `ct`.`locale` = 'tr' where `o`.`deleted_at` is null and `o`.`status` not in ('canceled', 'refunded') and `o`.`created_at` between '2025-11-25 00:00:00' and '2025-12-24 23:59:59' and `p`.`primary_category_id` is not null group by `p`.`primary_category_id` order by SUM(op.qty) desc limit 10

select p.brand_id as brand_id, MAX(bt.name) as name, SUM(op.qty) as orders_qty, SUM(op.line_total) as revenue from `order_products` as `op` inner join `orders` as `o` on `o`.`id` = `op`.`order_id` inner join `products` as `p` on `p`.`id` = `op`.`product_id` left join `brand_translations` as `bt` on `bt`.`brand_id` = `p`.`brand_id` and `bt`.`locale` = 'tr' where `o`.`deleted_at` is null and `o`.`status` not in ('canceled', 'refunded') and `o`.`created_at` between '2025-11-25 00:00:00' and '2025-12-24 23:59:59' and `p`.`brand_id` is not null group by `p`.`brand_id` order by SUM(op.qty) desc limit 10

select COALESCE(NULLIF(traffic_source, ''), 'other') as source, COUNT(*) as orders, SUM(total) as revenue from `orders` where `status` not in ('canceled', 'refunded') and `created_at` between '2025-11-25 00:00:00' and '2025-12-24 23:59:59' and `orders`.`deleted_at` is null group by COALESCE(NULLIF(traffic_source, ''), 'other')

select HOUR(created_at) as hour, COUNT(*) as orders, SUM(total) as revenue from `orders` where `status` not in ('canceled', 'refunded') and `created_at` between '2025-11-25 00:00:00' and '2025-12-24 23:59:59' and `orders`.`deleted_at` is null group by HOUR(created_at) order by HOUR(created_at) asc
select count(*) as aggregate from `orders` where `status` not in ('canceled', 'refunded') and `created_at` between '2025-11-25 00:00:00' and '2025-12-24 23:59:59' and `orders`.`deleted_at` is null
